issues.problem: The narration claims 'n elements need only about log₂ n comparisons' without explaining why this is true (no derivation or invariant stated).
issues.fix: Add a short sentence in the done beat or a dedicated beat explaining that the range size halves each step, so after k steps it is at most n/2^k, giving k ≈ log₂ n.

issues.problem: The prediction question 'lo hay hi đổi?' is asked before the mid frame is shown in the script (the speech comes before setState frame 2), so the student cannot yet see a[mid] to answer.
issues.fix: Move the prediction speech to after the setState that shows the mid frame, or rephrase the question to be answerable from the current frame.

issues.problem: The third pitfall (loop condition lo ≤ hi) has no language attached, but it is a general algorithmic pitfall; the schema expects a language for language-specific pitfalls.
issues.fix: Either mark it as a general pitfall explicitly or attach it to both cpp and py.

issues.problem: The map for Python line 4 maps pseudo line 4 to py lines 5-6, but py line 5 is the if condition and line 6 is the return; this is correct but the map for pseudo line 5 maps to py lines 7-8, which is also correct. No issue found here, but the map does not include the function definition line 1, which is fine.

Frame 13 (lo=7, hi=6) is tagged codeLine 7 (return −1) although the loop condition at line 2 has not yet been re-evaluated; the frame shows the state after the last update, not the execution of line 7. Frame 14 repeats codeLine 7 with the same state, so the two frames are indistinguishable in code position.
issues.fix: Insert a frame with codeLine 2 showing the failed check lo ≤ hi (7 ≤ 6 false) before the return frame, or move the 'return −1' tag to a frame that follows that check.

issues.problem: Frame 12 sets lo = 7 with hi = 6 and mutes all bars, so the visual state is already 'empty range' while the explanation still says target is on the right; the next frame repeats the same all-muted picture, weakening the contrast between 'range narrowed' and 'range empty'.
issues.fix: In frame 12 keep index 6 (the just-compared mid) in a distinct 'compare/just-checked' style and only mute everything in frame 13, so the transition to the empty range is visible.

issues.problem: The prediction 'Theo em, bước tiếp theo lo hay hi đổi?' is asked at the frame where mid has just been selected but the comparison result is not yet visible (frame 2/5), so the student cannot yet see which side will be dropped; the answer only becomes visible in the following frame.
issues.fix: Ask the prediction after the comparison is shown (e.g. at the frame where a[mid] and target are both displayed with the compare highlight), or rephrase the question to 'a[mid] so với target thế nào?' at the mid frame.

issues.problem: The pitfall has no 'lang' field while the other two are language-tagged; it is a general algorithmic pitfall, so its placement is ambiguous.
issues.fix: Add an explicit language tag (e.g. 'both'/'general') or state in the text that it applies to both implementations.

issues.problem: The script jumps from frame 8 to frame 9 to frame 11 without narrating the loop-condition checks at frames 10 (lo ≤ hi) and without a speech for frame 10, so the spoken lesson skips a step that the frames contain.
issues.fix: Either add a short speech for the condition check at frame 10 or mark condition-check frames as non-narrated so the jump is intentional.

issues.problem: English narration uses the plural '1 comparisons' (also '3 comparisons' is fine, but '1 comparisons' is ungrammatical); the Vietnamese side is correct.
